notes: «عن عمه محمد بن أبي القاسم» folds the uncle into one link (rule 7); «رضي الله عنه» and «عليه السلام» are left out
«أخبرني من سمع» is an unnamed transmitter; Rida is named inside the chain, so he stays a narrator, not imam_in_text
Rule 11: a narrated encounter in which the Imam speaks and acts («أنا وهارون هكذا»); source or only in the scene is a ruling
